==Notes==
* Has 4700 health in hard mode. 
* When defeated, a [[Chest of Burrows]] spawns.
* Flag your [[Hero]]es and [[Henchman|Henchmen]] around Frostmaw to protect them from [[Wurm Siege]]. 
* Keep an eye on her dust cloud while she moves underground to predict where she will pop up, which will always be directly in front of her target.
* Use your allies ([[Gareth]], [[Hroth]], [[Kitta]], [[Latham]]) to [[tank]] her, allowing your [[party]] to attack from a safe distance.
* You cannot [[capture#Capturing skills|capture]] [[Dark Apostasy]] from Frostmaw, since she is not a [[boss]].
* Cannot be blinded.

==Trivia==
* She is the largest creature in the game next to [[Abaddon]].
